# Firstlight UI

> Current public documentation for firstlightui/nativephp.

- Website: https://firstlightui.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/firstlightui/nativephp
- Package: firstlightui/nativephp

## Documentation

- [Install Firstlight UI](https://firstlightui.dev/getting-started/installation): Install Firstlight, register its NativePHP plugin, and rebuild the native projects.
- [Add your first Firstlight component](https://firstlightui.dev/getting-started/first-component): Add a Segmented control whose selected value is managed by PHP.
- [Theme Firstlight components](https://firstlightui.dev/getting-started/theming): Configure the semantic NativePHP theme tokens that Firstlight components inherit on iOS and Android.
- [SuperNative components](https://firstlightui.dev/concepts/supernative-components): How Firstlight turns shared EDGE markup into genuine iOS and Android controls.
- [Server-authoritative state](https://firstlightui.dev/concepts/server-authoritative-state): How Firstlight reconciles immediate native interaction with values accepted and published by PHP.
- [How Firstlight complements NativePHP Mobile UI](https://firstlightui.dev/concepts/firstlight-and-mobile-ui): How Firstlight builds on NativePHP Mobile UI with a focused, opinionated form and control layer.
- [Activity Indicator](https://firstlightui.dev/components/activity-indicator): Indeterminate native activity, semantic sizes, conditional presence, accessibility announcements, validation, and platform behaviour.
- [Button](https://firstlightui.dev/components/button): Public API, variants, states, accessibility, adapter behaviour, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Button.
- [Callout](https://firstlightui.dev/components/callout): Persistent semantic messages, tones, optional actions, accessibility, validation, and native platform behaviour.
- [Transient Feedback](https://firstlightui.dev/components/transient-feedback): Publish queued app-level outcomes with semantic tones, optional actions, automatic or held lifetime, and Laravel application events.
- [Badge](https://firstlightui.dev/components/badge): Public API, count formatting, tones, accessibility, validation, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Badge.
- [Checkbox](https://firstlightui.dev/components/checkbox): Strict Boolean form and checklist state, field metadata, server-authoritative proposals, accessibility, and native platform behaviour.
- [Choice Group](https://firstlightui.dev/components/choice-group): Public API, selection modes, state timing, accessibility, and platform behaviour for Firstlight Choice Group.
- [Confirmation Dialog](https://firstlightui.dev/components/confirmation-dialog): Ask for one native confirmation with explicit cancellation and destructive action semantics.
- [Modal](https://firstlightui.dev/components/modal): Full-screen native overlay for authored content with server-controlled visibility and dismissal.
- [Bottom Sheet](https://firstlightui.dev/components/bottom-sheet): Native bottom sheet for authored content with server-controlled visibility and dismissal.
- [Date Picker](https://firstlightui.dev/components/date-picker): Canonical nullable dates, inclusive bounds, native confirmation, localisation, and accessibility for Firstlight Date Picker.
- [Time Picker](https://firstlightui.dev/components/time-picker): Choose a wall-clock time with a native, server-authoritative picker.
- [Icon Button](https://firstlightui.dev/components/icon-button): Public API, variants, sizes, loading and disabled states, accessibility, and native platform behaviour for Firstlight Icon Button.
- [List Item](https://firstlightui.dev/components/list-item): Application row content, actions, icon overrides, disabled behaviour, accessibility, and native platform expression.
- [List](https://firstlightui.dev/components/list): Finite vertical collections of List Item rows with optional grouped sections, separators, and refresh or pagination hooks.
- [List Section](https://firstlightui.dev/components/list-section): Grouped headers, footers, and List Item rows inside a parent List container.
- [Pill Group](https://firstlightui.dev/components/pill-group): Public API, selection modes, state timing, accessibility, validation, and platform behaviour for Firstlight Pill Group.
- [Progress](https://firstlightui.dev/components/progress): Determinate and indeterminate work progress, values, accessibility, validation, adapter behaviour, and platform evidence.
- [Segmented](https://firstlightui.dev/components/segmented): Public API, state, accessibility, validation, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Segmented.
- [Search Field](https://firstlightui.dev/components/search-field): Public API, focused query synchronisation, native clear and submit behaviour, accessibility, and platform expression for Firstlight Search Field.
- [Select](https://firstlightui.dev/components/select): Public API, stable values, searchable presentation, state timing, accessibility, and platform behaviour for Firstlight Select.
- [Slider](https://firstlightui.dev/components/slider): Strict numeric grids, native draft synchronisation, accessibility, and paired platform behavior for Firstlight Slider.
- [Stepper](https://firstlightui.dev/components/stepper): Move an exact integer or decimal value through a bounded native stepper.
- [Status Label](https://firstlightui.dev/components/status-label): Public API, tones, accessibility, validation, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Status Label.
- [Text Field](https://firstlightui.dev/components/text-field): Public API, focused editing, semantic input hints, icons, accessibility, and platform behaviour for Firstlight Text Field.
- [Text Area](https://firstlightui.dev/components/text-area): Public API, multiline editing, line bounds, synchronisation, accessibility, and native platform behaviour for Firstlight Text Area.
- [Switch](https://firstlightui.dev/components/switch): Public API, state, accessibility, validation, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Switch.
- [Compatibility](https://firstlightui.dev/reference/compatibility): Current language, framework, platform, and Swift package requirements for Firstlight UI.
